description: Test questions for homelab inventory assistant evaluation

questions.question: What is the IP address of pve-main?
How much RAM does the database server have?
questions.expected: 256GB

questions.question: What CPU is in llm-rig-04?
questions.expected: AMD Threadripper 3960X (24 cores, 48 threads)

questions.question: What is the role of mini-pc-02?
questions.expected: Pi-hole DNS

questions.question: What GPUs does llm-rig-05 have?
questions.expected: RTX 3090 Ti (24GB) and RTX 3060 Ti (8GB)

questions.question: Where is the media server located?
questions.expected: Rack 1, U21

questions.question: What motherboard is in the desktop workstation?
questions.expected: ASUS ROG Crosshair VIII

questions.question: How many SFP+ ports does switch-core have?
What is the IP address of the Kubernetes master node?
What CPU is in the nas-offsite server?
questions.expected: Intel Celeron J4125 (4 cores, 4 threads)

questions.question: What is the PSU wattage of llm-rig-05?
What model switch provides PoE?
questions.expected: Ubiquiti UniFi Switch 24 PoE

questions.question: What is the storage capacity of the NVMe drive in pve-main?
questions.expected: 2000GB (2TB) Samsung 980 Pro

questions.question: What runs on mini-pc-04?
questions.expected: Home Assistant OS

questions.question: What GPU is in k8s-worker-01?
questions.expected: NVIDIA T4 (16GB)

questions.question: What is the total RAM across all servers?
How many devices have 10GbE networking?
questions.expected: 12 (pve-main, pve-backup, nas-primary x2, k8s-master-01, k8s-worker-01, k8s-worker-02, db-server x2, llm-rig-01 through llm-rig-05)

questions.question: What is the total GPU VRAM available across all LLM rigs?
questions.expected: 76GB (6+6+8+8+24+24+8 = 84GB across llm-rig-01 to llm-rig-05)

questions.question: How many spare GPUs are available?
questions.expected: 3 (2x GTX 1660 Super + 1x RTX 3090 Ti)

questions.question: What is the total NVMe storage capacity in the database server?
How many systems are running in Rack 1?
questions.expected: 11 servers plus 2 switches

questions.question: What is the total RAM across all LLM rigs?
How many CPU cores are in all desktop systems combined?
What is the total PoE budget available?
questions.expected: 400W (from switch-poe)

questions.question: How many systems have Intel CPUs?
questions.expected: 12 (pve-backup, nas-offsite, k8s-master-01, k8s-worker-01, k8s-worker-02, db-server, media-server, monitoring-server, mini-pc-01, mini-pc-02, mini-pc-03, mini-pc-05, desktop-gaming, desktop-guest)

questions.question: What is the total HDD capacity in the NAS servers?
questions.expected: 168TB (6x18TB in nas-primary + 4x8TB in nas-offsite + 8x16TB in pve-backup = 108+32+128)

questions.question: How many spare RAM modules are available?
What is the total spare NVMe storage available?
questions.expected: 4TB (2x 1000GB Samsung 970 EVO Plus + 1x 2000GB Crucial P3 Plus)

questions.question: How many Noctua cooling products are in spare parts?
questions.expected: 5 (4x NF-A12x25 fans + 1x NH-D15 cooler)

questions.question: Which systems have GPUs with more than 10GB VRAM?
questions.expected: k8s-worker-01 (T4 16GB), desktop-gaming (4070 Ti 12GB), llm-rig-04 (3090 Ti 24GB), llm-rig-05 (3090 Ti 24GB + 3060 Ti 8GB)

questions.question: List all systems with more than 128GB of RAM.
questions.expected: pve-main (256GB), db-server (256GB), llm-rig-04 (256GB), llm-rig-05 (256GB)

questions.question: Which mini PCs have dual 2.5GbE networking?
questions.expected: mini-pc-01, mini-pc-02, mini-pc-03 (all three N100-based units)

questions.question: What systems use AMD EPYC CPUs?
questions.expected: pve-main (EPYC 7302), db-server (EPYC 7302P)

questions.question: Which desktops have dedicated graphics cards (not integrated)?
questions.expected: desktop-workstation (RTX 3080), desktop-gaming (RTX 4070 Ti), desktop-guest (GTX 1650), desktop-test (RX 6600 XT)

questions.question: List systems with IPMI support.
questions.expected: pve-main, pve-backup, k8s-master-01, db-server, monitoring-server

questions.question: Which systems have AMD Ryzen 9 5950X CPUs?
questions.expected: desktop-workstation, llm-rig-01, llm-rig-02, llm-rig-03

questions.question: Which servers have 8 RAM slots?
questions.expected: pve-main (8/8 used), pve-backup (4/8 used), db-server (8/8 used), llm-rig-04 (8/8 used), llm-rig-05 (8/8 used)

questions.question: List all systems with Supermicro motherboards.
questions.expected: pve-main (H12SSL-i), pve-backup (X10SRH-CF), k8s-master-01 (X11SCH-F), k8s-worker-01 (X11SCH-F), k8s-worker-02 (X11SCH-F), db-server (H12SSL-i), monitoring-server (X11SCL-F)

questions.question: Which systems are fanless?
questions.expected: mini-pc-01, mini-pc-02, mini-pc-03 (all N100 mini PCs)

questions.question: Which systems have WiFi capability?
questions.expected: desktop-gaming (WiFi 6E), desktop-htpc (WiFi 6), mini-pc-04 (WiFi 6)

questions.question: List all systems with PSU over 800W.
questions.expected: desktop-workstation (850W), desktop-gaming (850W), llm-rig-01 (1000W), llm-rig-04 (1200W), llm-rig-05 (1600W)

questions.question: Which systems have Thunderbolt connectivity?
questions.expected: mini-pc-05 (Thunderbolt 4)

questions.question: List servers with Intel Xeon CPUs.
questions.expected: pve-backup (Xeon E5-2680 v4), k8s-master-01 (Xeon E-2278G), k8s-worker-01 (Xeon E-2278G), k8s-worker-02 (Xeon E-2278G), monitoring-server (Xeon E-2224)

questions.question: What RAM is compatible with the ASUS PRIME B550-PLUS motherboard?
questions.expected: DDR4 3200MHz 32GB modules (2 available in spare parts)

questions.question: Can I add more RAM to llm-rig-01?
questions.expected: No, all 4 slots are used (4/4 slots with 128GB total)

questions.question: What spare GPUs could I add to llm-rig-02?
questions.expected: 2x GTX 1660 Super (6GB each) or 1x RTX 3090 Ti (24GB) from spare parts

questions.question: Is the spare NH-D15 cooler compatible with the desktop workstation's CPU socket?
questions.expected: Yes, the NH-D15 supports AM4/AM5 and the desktop-workstation uses AMD Ryzen 9 5950X (AM4)

questions.question: What RAM would work in the Kubernetes worker nodes?
questions.expected: DDR4 ECC 2666MHz (compatible with Supermicro X11SCH-F), 4 spare modules available

questions.question: Can I use the spare 10GbE NICs with switch-core?
questions.expected: Yes, the Intel X520-DA2 is SFP+ and switch-core has 16 SFP+ ports. Use with 10GBASE-SR modules or DAC cables.

questions.question: Can I add more RAM to the desktop workstation?
questions.expected: Yes, it has 2/4 slots used. The 2x DDR4 3200MHz 32GB spare modules are compatible with ASUS ROG Crosshair VIII.

questions.question: What spare storage can be used in llm-rig-02?
questions.expected: Samsung 970 EVO Plus 1TB NVMe (2 available) or Crucial P3 Plus 2TB NVMe (1 available)

questions.question: Is the spare DDR4 ECC 3200MHz RAM compatible with pve-backup?
questions.expected: No, pve-backup uses DDR4 ECC 2400MHz (Supermicro X10SRH-CF). The spare ECC 3200MHz is for Supermicro H12SSL-i.

questions.question: Can I use the DDR5 spare RAM in desktop-gaming?
questions.expected: No, desktop-gaming uses DDR5 5600MHz while spare is DDR5 4800MHz SO-DIMM (for mini PCs). Form factor incompatible.

questions.question: What spare PSU could upgrade llm-rig-02?
questions.expected: Corsair RM850x (850W) would be an upgrade from current 750W PSU

questions.question: Can the spare DDR4 3600MHz RAM be used in llm-rig-04?
questions.expected: Yes, llm-rig-04 has ASUS ROG Zenith II Extreme which uses DDR4 3600MHz. However, all 8 slots are already used.

questions.question: If I want to build a new LLM rig with maximum GPU VRAM from spare parts, what would the configuration be?
questions.expected: Use the spare RTX 3090 Ti (24GB) for maximum single-GPU VRAM, or combine with 2x GTX 1660 Super for 36GB total (but mixed GPU performance considerations)

questions.question: What is the highest RAM capacity system I could upgrade using spare parts?
questions.expected: pve-backup has 4/8 slots used with 128GB, could add 4x 32GB DDR4 ECC 3200MHz spare modules (if compatible with Supermicro X10SRH-CF - need to verify ECC 3200 vs 2400 compatibility)

questions.question: Which system would be best for running a 70B parameter LLM model?
questions.expected: llm-rig-05 with 32GB total VRAM (3090 Ti 24GB + 3060 Ti 8GB) would be best. Could also use llm-rig-04 with 24GB for smaller quantized versions.

questions.question: What is the total power supply capacity across all LLM rigs?
If nas-primary fails and I need to restore from backup, what are my options?
questions.expected: pve-backup has 128TB HDD backup storage, nas-offsite has 32TB with nightly backups. Total 160TB backup capacity available.

questions.question: What's the most cost-effective way to add 10GbE to desktop-workstation?
questions.expected: Use one of the 2 spare Intel X520-DA2 NICs (10GbE SFP+), connect to switch-core via spare 10GBASE-SR module or DAC cable

questions.question: Which systems could benefit from the spare Noctua NF-A12x25 fans?
questions.expected: Any system with 120mm fan mounts. Best candidates: desktop-workstation, desktop-gaming, desktop-test, llm-rigs. All are standard ATX cases.

questions.question: If I need to run a distributed LLM across multiple machines, which systems should I use?
questions.expected: llm-rig-04 and llm-rig-05 both have dual 10GbE for high-speed interconnect, Threadripper CPUs, and high VRAM GPUs. Combined: 56GB VRAM, 48 cores.

questions.question: What's the maximum expandable storage in nas-primary?
questions.expected: Currently 6x 18TB drives. ASRock Rack X570D4U-2L2T likely supports more drives. Could add 2x spare WD Red Plus 8TB drives if bays available.

questions.question: If k8s-worker-01's T4 GPU fails, what are replacement options from spare parts?
questions.expected: Could use GTX 1660 Super (6GB, 2 available) or RTX 3090 Ti (24GB) from spare parts. 3090 Ti is significant upgrade but may need PSU upgrade (currently 500W).

questions.question: Calculate total system RAM if all spare RAM is installed in compatible systems.
questions.expected: Current total across all systems plus spare: Add 4x32GB ECC to systems with H12SSL-i, 2x32GB to B550-PLUS/ROG Crosshair VIII, etc. Spares add 448GB potential (14x32GB).

questions.question: What would be needed to add a third Kubernetes worker node?
questions.expected: Need server with Supermicro X11SCH-F (like existing workers), DDR4 ECC 2666MHz RAM (4 spare modules available), and 10GbE NIC (2 X520-DA2 available).

questions.question: Got anything beefy for running big AI models?
questions.expected: llm-rig-04 and llm-rig-05 are the most capable: rig-04 has RTX 3090 Ti (24GB), rig-05 has 3090 Ti + 3060 Ti (32GB total). Both have Threadripper CPUs and 256GB RAM.

questions.question: What's good for transcoding videos?
questions.expected: media-server has Intel Core i5-12400 with Intel UHD 730 integrated graphics supporting Quick Sync for hardware transcoding

questions.question: I need something quiet for the living room. Any suggestions?
questions.expected: desktop-htpc (ASRock DeskMini X300 with Ryzen 5 5600G, low 120W PSU) or the fanless N100 mini PCs if compute needs are minimal

questions.question: Where's all my backup storage?
questions.expected: pve-backup has 128TB HDD storage (8x 16TB Seagate Exos), nas-primary has ~72TB usable (6x 18TB in RAID-Z2), nas-offsite has 32TB (4x 8TB)

questions.question: What can handle a sudden traffic spike to my home lab services?
questions.expected: k8s-worker-01 and k8s-worker-02 are Kubernetes workers that can scale. db-server has high-speed Optane storage for database performance.

questions.question: What's the best box for playing games?
questions.expected: desktop-gaming has Intel Core i7-12700K, RTX 4070 Ti (12GB VRAM), 32GB DDR5, and 2TB NVMe. Located in living room.

questions.question: Need something low power that can run 24/7 for DNS.
questions.expected: mini-pc-02 and mini-pc-03 run Pi-hole DNS. They're fanless N100 systems using only 65W, perfect for 24/7 operation.

questions.question: What do I have for remote access?
questions.expected: mini-pc-05 runs WireGuard and Tailscale as remote access gateway. Has Thunderbolt 4 and Intel Core i5-1240P.

questions.question: Is there anything with lots of fast storage for databases?
questions.expected: db-server has Intel Optane P5800X (800GB) for WAL and 4x Samsung PM9A3 (3840GB each) for data. Total 16TB+ NVMe with extreme low-latency Optane.

questions.question: What's managing my smart home stuff?
questions.expected: mini-pc-04 runs Home Assistant OS. It has AMD Ryzen 7 5700U, 32GB RAM, and is located in the utility room.

questions.question: Got any machines for testing and experimenting?
questions.expected: desktop-test is specifically for testing and experiments. Has Ryzen 7 3700X, RX 6600 XT, 32GB RAM. Located on lab bench.

questions.question: What's monitoring everything?
questions.expected: monitoring-server runs Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki with 30 days metrics retention. Intel Xeon E-2224, 32GB RAM, 1TB NVMe.

questions.question: Which machine would be good for compiling large codebases?
questions.expected: desktop-workstation with Ryzen 9 5950X (16 cores/32 threads), 64GB RAM, and fast NVMe storage. Or llm-rig-04/05 with Threadripper 3960X (24 cores/48 threads) if GPU not needed.

questions.question: What's good for hosting containers?
questions.expected: mini-pc-01 is specifically a Docker host. For heavier workloads, the k8s cluster (k8s-master-01, k8s-worker-01, k8s-worker-02) provides orchestrated containers.

questions.question: If I move one GTX 1660 Super from spare parts to llm-rig-02, what changes?
questions.expected: llm-rig-02 would have RTX 3060 Ti + GTX 1660 Super (14GB total VRAM). Spare GPUs would be: 1x GTX 1660 Super, 1x RTX 3090 Ti

questions.question: What happens if I want to add the spare RTX 3090 Ti to llm-rig-01?
questions.expected: llm-rig-01 would have 2x GTX 1660 Super + RTX 3090 Ti (36GB total), but may need PSU upgrade (currently 1000W). Mixed GPU configs need pipeline parallelism.

questions.question: If nas-primary fails, what's my backup storage situation?
questions.expected: pve-backup has 128TB HDD for Proxmox backups, nas-offsite has 32TB for offsite replication. Total backup capacity: 160TB

questions.question: If I install all spare DDR4 3200MHz RAM into compatible systems, what's the new configuration?
questions.expected: Add 2x 32GB to desktop-workstation (now 128GB total, 4/4 slots). ASUS PRIME B550-PLUS compatible but llm-rigs have all slots used.

questions.question: What if I need to decommission switch-core for maintenance?
questions.expected: All 10GbE connections would be lost. switch-poe has 2 SFP+ ports for partial 10GbE backup. 16 devices currently rely on switch-core's 16 SFP+ ports.

questions.question: If I add both spare Intel X520-DA2 NICs to systems, which would benefit most?
questions.expected: desktop-workstation (currently only 2.5GbE) and desktop-gaming (2.5GbE + WiFi) would benefit most from 10GbE upgrade for development and data transfer.

questions.question: What changes if I move the T4 GPU from k8s-worker-01 to k8s-worker-02?
questions.expected: k8s-worker-01 loses GPU workload capability. k8s-worker-02 gains T4 (16GB). Both need PSU review - worker-01 can reduce to 400W, worker-02 may need upgrade from 400W.

questions.question: If I use all spare SSDs for additional storage, where should they go?
questions.expected: 3x Samsung 870 EVO 500GB (SATA) could go to systems with SATA ports: desktop-guest, nas-offsite. 2x 970 EVO Plus + 1x P3 Plus (NVMe) to systems with M.2 slots.

questions.question: What spare parts would I need to buy to max out llm-rig-03's RAM?
questions.expected: llm-rig-03 has 4/4 slots with 128GB DDR4 3200MHz. All slots full, cannot add more RAM. Would need higher density modules or different motherboard.

questions.question: If both spare PSUs are deployed, which systems benefit most?
questions.expected: Corsair RM850x (850W) could upgrade llm-rig-02 or llm-rig-03 (both 750W). Seasonic 750W could be backup for similarly powered systems.

questions.question: What is the IP address of web-server-01?
questions.expected: Not found in inventory - no system named web-server-01 exists

questions.question: How much VRAM does pve-main have?
questions.expected: pve-main has no GPUs installed

questions.question: What is the WiFi password for the home network?
questions.expected: Not available in inventory - this inventory tracks hardware, not network credentials

questions.question: Can I upgrade the RAM in the Intel N100 mini PCs?
questions.expected: Limited - they have 1/1 RAM slot used. The DDR5 4800MHz SO-DIMM spare modules are compatible but would require replacing existing RAM, not adding to it.

questions.question: What GPU does nas-primary have?
questions.expected: nas-primary has no GPUs installed

questions.question: How do I connect to the cloud backup service?
questions.expected: Not available in inventory - this inventory tracks local hardware only, not cloud service configurations

questions.question: What is the warranty status of the servers?
questions.expected: Warranty information is not tracked in this inventory

questions.question: Can I add DDR5 RAM to pve-main?
questions.expected: No, pve-main uses DDR4 ECC 3200MHz. DDR4 and DDR5 are physically incompatible.

questions.question: What is the price of the spare RTX 3090 Ti?
questions.expected: Price information is not tracked in this inventory
